articles.title: Why US Treasury bond yields matter, what it means for Indian investors, and the impact on rupee
articles.description: Cutting through money jargon, one topic at a time. This week, Sanket Dhanorkar explains why yields on US Treasury bonds matter, and what it means for Indian investors. Rising US bond yields mean investors are demanding a higher return to buy and hold that debt. This reflects concerns over the weak fiscal position of the US and the inflationary impact from steep oil prices.

articles.title: Brent at $102; Oil prices swing on volatile West Asia war
articles.description: Oil prices swung on October 5 as West Asia war stalled, but fresh fighting in Yemen and Houthi threats to Saudi oil facilities kept Brent crude above $102 a barrel.

articles.title: Capex is happening across sectors but will intensify once external issues ease: Abakkus Asset's Sunil Singhania
articles.description: Chairman and managing director at Abakkus Asset Manager Pvt. Ltd, Sunil Singhania, said near-term market sentiment is being weighed down by West Asia war, which is keeping oil prices, inflation concerns and bond yields elevated, though India's growth and corporate earnings outlook are healthy.

articles.title: Stocks in news: HDFC Bank, Infosys, Yes Bank, Hindustan Zinc and RVNL
articles.description: Indian equities continued their downward trend due to rising global bond yields and high crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 fell by 198.50 points, while the BSE Sensex decreased by 570.59 points. Key companies like HDFC Bank and Infosys made significant corporate announcements amidst these market conditions. HDFC Bank appointed a new Managing Director and CEO following regulatory approval.

articles.title: Cash, derivatives volumes sink as oil, yields roil sentiment
articles.description: Trading activity in Indian stock markets plummeted in Q2, with a decline in cash and derivatives volumes due to rising bond yields, foreign outflows, and regulatory changes. The Nifty 500 index dropped 4%, primarily influenced by soaring oil prices and foreign selling.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia cuts oil prices for Asia in November
articles.description: Saudi Arabia cuts November oil prices for Asia while raising prices for Europe, maintaining steady production targets in the latest OPEC+ agreement. Read more at straitstimes.com.
